Hope you’re well — our renewal window for several tooling contracts is coming up in June and we’re consolidating into a single procurement cycle. Can Redwood provide a combined quote for: GitHub Enterprise (org-wide), JetBrains (IDE seats), and Atlassian (Jira + Confluence)?

- Current seat counts (by product/team) and recommended SKUs for next 12 months
- Any multi-product discount tiers or committed-seat pricing
- Your standard SSO/SAML onboarding lead time and any migration services for JetBrains seat transfers
- A sample SOW and timeline for procurement/legal review (DocuSign-friendly)

Attaching our internal license snapshot for context. Please let me know who on your side I should work with for pricing and procurement. Ideally we’ll close commercial terms by May 20.

Thanks,

Hi Sam — looping in with preliminary guidance.

Summary of what influences price: committed seats, term length (12 vs 24 months), and cross-product bundling. Based on similar mid-market customers, a combined 10–15% discount is typical at our 12‑month commit level; 18–25% is achievable with a 24‑month or higher committed seat minimum.

Two quick asks to tighten numbers:
- Can you confirm if any teams are moving to remote-first workflows that would require adding 20% buffer to active seat counts?
- Do you plan to maintain separate Jira projects per product team (affects Confluence seat mapping)?

I’ve attached a draft SOW template and the initial line-item draft for a bundle. Laura — can you confirm invoice cadence options (monthly vs. annual prepaid) and any PO/Tax requirements for Orbit?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Orbit_SOW_v3.pdf

From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@orbit-analytics.com>

Subject: Re: Renewal window + consolidated quote request

Thanks, team — this is helpful. A few clarifications:

- We expect a modest hiring wave in Q3; please model a 12% growth buffer on active seats.
- We’d like to evaluate a 24-month committed option if it improves unit economics.
- JetBrains: we have floating licenses through a reseller today; migration to seat-based managed by Redwood is preferred but we'd like a migration plan and an estimate for any consultant costs.
- Procurement prefers annual prepaid if the discount delta is >10% — please show both annual and monthly invoice scenarios.

We reviewed the SOW and added a comment for an explicit data-retention clause for logs and audit artifacts. Can you surface your SOC2 evidence and confirm Audit log export retention details for Private deployments?

Next steps: please send the consolidated quote and a DocuSign link by Apr 12 for internal review. If possible, include a one-page migration checklist for JetBrains.

Best,
Sam
Sr. Procurement Manager, Orbit Analytics
